direction.description: Lineage vocabulary: upstream, downstream, or both. Default both. Ignored for discover.

idempotency_key.description: Required after authentication; scoped to trusted tenant, actor, tool, and operation.

include_documents.description: Default false; only an approved read-only document capability may honor true.

max_depth.description: Lineage traversal depth. Default 3; absolute server cap 8.

max_edges.description: Traversal/edge response bound. Default and absolute server cap 5000.

max_nodes.description: Traversal/node response bound. Default and absolute server cap 1000.

operation.description: Required server vocabulary: discover or lineage. Conditional rules are server-enforced.

refresh.description: Default false. False is explicitly read-only; true requests a complete exact-scope refresh and requires the refresh capability.
